items.title: Caves of Qud: Diaspora breaks new ground by being the first early access DLC release on Steam
items.zh_title: 《Caves of Qud: Diaspora》开创先河，成为 Steam 上首个抢先体验 DLC
items.summary: The roguelike RPG is no longer in Steam Early Access, but its upcoming DLC Diaspora will be, marking untrodden ground for the in-development program.
items.zh_summary: 这款 Roguelike RPG 已脱离 Steam 抢先体验，但其后续 DLC《Diaspora》将以抢先体验形式推出，为这一仍在开发中的项目开创了先例。

items.title: Dev snapshot: Godot 4.8 beta 1
items.summary: It’s that time of the release cycle once again: the beta snapshot! With this, 4.8 is fully in feature-freeze, and developer resources have shifted exclusively to creating and reviewing various regress…
items.zh_summary: 又到了发布周期中的 Beta 快照时间，4.8 已全面进入功能冻结阶段，开发资源全部转向制作和审核各类回归修复，官方再次邀请大家参加找 Bug 冲刺活动，一起把 Beta 期间冒出来的 Bug 清掉。

items.title: Ubisoft to close Trials studio RedLynx, downsize Ubisoft Singapore
items.zh_title: Ubisoft 将关闭《Trials》工作室 RedLynx，并缩减 Ubisoft Singapore 规模
items.summary: The decisions will ultimately impact over 120 jobs between the two studios as part of Ubisoft's ongoing restructuring efforts.
items.zh_summary: 作为 Ubisoft 持续重组的一部分，这两项决定最终将影响两家工作室 120 多个岗位。

items.title: No more hand-written code? Epic's Disney project reportedly shifts to 'AI-First' development
items.zh_title: 不再手写代码？据报道 Epic 的 Disney 项目转向“AI 优先”开发
items.summary: Developers working on the upcoming Star Wars and Marvel shooter have been reportedly instructed to lean heavily on AI, especially during the creation of code and art.
items.zh_summary: 据报道，正在开发的《Star Wars》和 Marvel 射击游戏团队已被要求大量使用 AI，尤其是在代码和美术创作上。
